d_rationales: Moving the gate electrodes of the dot widens that dot only; it shares no wall with the well of the electron, so the width of the well and the photon wavelength are the stated ones.
The well was widened only after the electron had made the transition, an event after the stated process; the transition took place in the well of the stated width.
values.scene_clause: The walls of the well are set by gate electrodes. A quantum dot on the same chip is defined by gate electrodes of its own.
